alarms.action: Conveyor stops immediately; M191 latches/sets fault flag M199
alarms.condition: Motor overload contact MOL-1001 open (X13 low)
alarms.name: Motor Overload

alarms.action: Conveyor stops; latches jam alarm M190 until fault reset (PB-0002 / X1)
alarms.condition: Entry photo-eye PE-1002 blocked for more than 5.0 s while conveyor is running
alarms.name: Jam Alarm

conflicts.program_says: Not implemented (T10 timer coil and jam detection logic missing from program)

interlocks.effect: Conveyor motor M-1001 (Y10) stops immediately via alarm M191 / M199

interlocks.cause: Pallet jam detected (PE-1002 blocked > 5.0 s while running)
interlocks.effect: Conveyor motor M-1001 (Y10) stops immediately via jam alarm M190 / M199

interlocks.cause: Auto mode not active (SS-0003 / X2 OFF)
interlocks.effect: Conveyor motor M-1001 (Y10) is inhibited from running

steps.entry: Auto mode selected (X2 ON) and no ST10 fault active (M199 OFF)
steps.exit: E-stop tripped (X0 OFF), motor overload tripped (X13 OFF), or jam alarm raised (M190 ON)
steps.name: Conveyor Running

steps.exit: Release pulse timer elapsed (T11 done, 2.0 s)
steps.name: Stopper Release
